name: Sparse Grid Volume Rendering (Foreground)
definition: A CUDA kernel that renders a ray through a sparse 3D grid (NeRF representation) using trilinear interpolation, accumulating color and opacity based on density (sigma) and spherical harmonics (SH) coefficients.
summary: Sparse Grid Volume Rendering (Foreground) is a CUDA method using sparse voxel grids and spherical harmonics that optimizes performance via warp-level parallelism, shared memory, and early termination.
